description: Run your Atera help desk and monitoring: open, update and comment on tickets and log time, manage customers and contacts, raise and resolve alerts, and read your devices, with triggers for new and changed tickets, replies, alerts, customers, contacts and devices going offline.

atera_agent_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a device running the Atera agent goes offline or comes back online, with its name, customer and when Atera last heard from it. It can run only for one of the two, or only for one customer. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.agent_id: The device's agent id, for 'Get device'.
output.created_at: When it was added to Atera (UTC).
output.customer_id: The id of the customer it belongs to.
output.device_link: A link that opens it in Atera.
output.folder_name: The folder it is filed in.
output.last_login_user: Who signed in to it last.
output.last_seen: When Atera last heard from it (UTC).
output.logged_in_users: Who is signed in to it.
output.machine_name: The computer's name, such as RECEPTION-PC.
output.os: Its operating system, such as Microsoft Windows 11 Pro.
output.os_type: Whether it is a workstation or a server.
output.reported_from_ip: The public address it last reported from.
output.vendor: Who made it, such as Dell Inc.

parameters.description: Only when devices go offline, or only when they come back online. Leave blank for both.

parameters.description: Only devices for this customer. Leave blank for every customer.
